reason: The simulation is not runnable: main() is empty, there is no Simulation.run loop, and critical subsystems (policy, risk, media, retail, enforcement, metrics) are not wired. With two iterations left, adding a minimal but functional run loop and restoring main() can convert the codebase from scaffolding to an executable simulation and enable evaluation. The next iteration should focus on orchestration and core wiring, then finalize metrics and minor logic fixes in the final iteration.

specific_areas: Implement Simulation.run() daily loop: risk signal, policy updates, enforcement allocation, media/gov guidance, agent decisions, visits, retail interactions, enforcement actions, and metrics aggregation
Restore functional main(): parse params (args or stdin), construct Simulation, run it, compute optional no-mandate counterfactual, print JSON via json.dumps
Add _update_location_policies(), _risk_signal(day), and _market_availability(); call them within run()
Integrate media and government guidance into agents’ beliefs daily (use media.reach and credibility)
Compute enforcement exposure from visited mandate locations and pass to Person.decide_to_wear_mask
Decrement masks_inventory when wearing; trigger simple purchase/restock cycle with rationing and price adjustment
Populate metrics: adoption_rate, compliance_over_time, churn, enforcement_actions_count, denials_count, mask_shortage_incidents, retailer_inventory_history, compliance_by_location_type
Use previous-day wearing snapshot for peer_adoption_rate and observed_public_wearing to avoid simultaneity
Add basic parameter validation and clamps to avoid ValueError; ensure JSON-serializable outputs
Clean up or justify unused imports if time permits
